text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Provisional: fitted to past weather on a screening run. Pinned PV capacity 29.6 points of capacity (the real-time vintage, not a measurement). Deviation holds 1% of the profile's energy. Weights and shapes are identified only up to the rotation the data fix. Forecast panels: blue band 80% and 90%, dashed purple N's median, black observed. Cold winter nights in the scored year: 13.'
